title: F-PM14 drainage-response runtime admission architecture invariants 1-30
assessment_basis: F-CI61 composes only the 11 exact F-PM14 production blobs independently qualified by F-VQ73. Admission metadata and gates add no production/reference semantics.

invariants.evidence: One shared SWAP kernel remains; admission creates no use-case-specific kernel.
The qualified drainage binding remains I/O-free; F-CI61 adds no kernel I/O.
Parameter, forcing/control, state and diagnostic roles remain separated.
No drainage-response persistent process state is introduced.
Response evaluation temporaries remain call/worker-local rather than per-column persistent scratch.
MultiSWAP isolation/order semantics from owner/VQ are preserved by exact blob admission.
Checkpoint/trial/commit/rollback semantics are unchanged; invalid response remains fail-closed.
Restart/warm-recompute semantics remain based on committed state with no hidden drainage state.
Generic non-calendar interval qualification is replayed in F-CI61.
No coupling-window alignment or duration constraint is added.
Transactional coupling remains core runtime functionality and is not bypassed.
Explicit groundwater interface H/q contract is outside and unchanged by the admitted source set.
Hard mass closure and single authoritative drainage transfer booking are independently replayed.
Per-level drainage response derivatives remain exposed; bottom-interface sensitivity authority is unchanged.
No structural extra full-SWAP coupling runs are introduced.
Admission adds no heavyweight per-column solver instance and preserves MultiSWAP execution semantics.
MODFLOW cell/tile fractions remain outside the SWAP kernel.
Optional deep-vadose component ownership remains external and untouched.
No deep-vadose/direct-coupling transfer storage is changed.
Drainage response consumes process_hydraulic_view_t and remains solver-implementation agnostic.
Shared process modules are reused; no solver-specific physics copy is admitted.
No HeadCalc-internal dependency is introduced.
Physical drainage variants remain separate from numerical/performance policy.
Direct response evaluation adds no unbounded retry/fallback loop or new performance claim.
Reference mode/solver authority remains available and unchanged.
Explicit response and mass-accounting diagnostics remain available.
Inactive columns acquire no drainage-response persistent state or mandatory cost.
Tile/system composition remains a runtime/coupler responsibility.
No .swp, path, midnight, day-length or direct-MODFLOW assumption is admitted.
F-CI61 explicitly rechecks all 30 invariants against exact source identity and fresh preservation replay.
